opportunities.title: [Bounty Claim] PR Review - PR #5533 (Bounty #73)
opportunities.summary: **Claimant:** kongzi123 **GitHub:** kongzi123 **RTC wallet:** `AhqbFaPBPLMMiaLDzA9WhQcyvv4hMxiteLhPk3NhG1iG` ### PR Details - PR: https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain/pull/5533 - Bounty program: https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties/issues/73 ### Review Summary Security-focused code review of PR #5533 (fix: fail closed when sync admin key is unset): - Bug analysis: correctly identified that `hmac.compare_digest(key, None)` throws TypeError when admin_key is unset, allowing authentication bypass - Fix verification: the triple-condition short-circuit (`not key or not admin_key or not hmac.compare_digest`) properly prevents compare_digest from receiving None - Security impact: HIGH priority — prevents unauthenticated access when admin_key is not configured (fail-open to fail-closed) - Test coverage: new test uses monkeypatch + spy to verify compare_digest is never called with unset admin key ### Expected Reward Security-focused code review under bounty #73: 15-20 RTC (+10 for finding security-relevant fix)
